products.title: Dell Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock SD25TB4
products.description: Maximize your workspace efficiency with the Dell SD25TB4 Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock station. This dock is designed for professionals who demand high performance with ultra-fast connectivity, security, and flexibility. It features dual Thunderbolt 4, dual DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.1, USB-C multi-mode, and a 2.5 GbE RJ45 port, supporting up to 4 external displays (one 8K, two 6K, or four WQHD). It delivers fast data transfer and full 130 W power delivery to your laptop. Its ambidextrous USB-C cable ensures easy routing in any desk setup. Four USB-A and one USB-C port deliver 10 Gb/s speeds for rapid backups, peripherals, and charging, making it a hub for intensive tasks. Built for enterprise deployment, it features hardware-based encryption, WPA-3 Wi-Fi, and remote management via Dell’s Device Management Console. A Kensington lock slot adds physical security for shared or open spaces. Compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Ubuntu, and RHEL, it fits virtually any ecosystem. Built with 65% recycled materials and eco-conscious packaging, this dock is an all-in-one workstation solution for power users, professionals, and IT teams who need security, performance, and flexibility in a single device. Bundle includes the Dell SD25TB4 Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock, two DisplayPort to DisplayPort cables, two USB-A to USB-C cables, two USB-C to USB-C cables, one Ethernet patch cable, adjustable cord straps, one HDMI cable, a cleaning kit, a USB Type C to HDMI 3.1 cable, and the MK540 Advanced Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo.
